name: KLEE
description: A symbolic execution engine for LLVM bitcode. The entries run it under its symbolic-argument harness, with fixed options or with options sampled uniformly from SymTuner's parameter space.

name: SymTuner
description: An independent tool that tunes KLEE's options adaptively. The entries run its artifact, ported to the study's KLEE build, under KLEE's symbolic-argument harness.

name: SymCC
description: Compilation-based concolic execution, run here as a hybrid with a fuzzer.

name: SymSan
description: Concolic execution based on dynamic data-flow analysis, run here as a hybrid with a fuzzer. The build is a reconstruction from the source of the artifact.

name: Agolic
description: An LLM agent that plans a campaign of short runs on a backend (KLEE, Direct-Input or AFL++) and chooses for each run its command-line arguments, inputs and seeds from the source code and the results so far.
